PROVISIONAL_LOCAL_BEST_IN_TESTED_POOL. +Mu Yanling, Wind Rider +Brotherhood Vertibird +Mirkwood Bats +Spectral Sailor +Malcolm, the Eyes / -Breeches, Brazen Plunderer -Imposter Mech -Fellwar Stone -Lotus Petal -Captain Lannery Storm. 35 lands and coloured sources unchanged; Vehicles 13 -> 13 (natively flying 4 -> 5, all 13 with Mu); Pirate/Assassin creatures 21 -> 21; creatures 24 -> 26; durable rocks 7 -> 6; strict turn-5 Edward castability 0.5283/0.6295 -> 0.5025/0.6038 play/draw (Petal excluded); average nonland MV 2.797 -> 2.844. No explicit owner keep cut. MODERATE confidence; no measured playtests.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged; Pass C first-priority test). Mirkwood Bats replaces Fateful Discovery and Fellwar Stone stays. Bounded test: Bats castable 0.8364 vs Fateful 0.6307 with 12 cards seen (baseline); with Manufactor and 2 qualifiers, Bats drains 6 per opponent vs Fateful's 6 draws. Not primary because Fateful Discovery is an explicit owner keep. Turn-5 castability equals the no-Petal baseline (0.5283/0.6295).

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged; Pass C secondary test). Bats replaces Adrestia, keeping Fellwar; costs a Vehicle (13 -> 12), so it is weaker on Edward's own text. Turn-5 castability equals the no-Petal baseline.
RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (four-swap, staged, below the floor; not owner-presentable by itself). The primary without Bats, keeping Fellwar Stone; choose it if the owner values the rock over the drain.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (five-swap, staged). Chandra, Spark Hunter animates a Vehicle each combat and makes a crew-1 Vehicle token every turn, but grants no evasion for Edward's theft trigger. MODERATE confidence.

RETAIN_ALTERNATIVE (six-swap, staged). Eagle Vision freeruns for {1}{U} after Edward (an Assassin and our commander) connects; it replaces the owner-retained Imperial Seal, which tutors Time Sieve, Locomotive or Manufactor for one mana. MODERATE confidence.
